gloss: to remain; to refuse to leave

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {居座|いすわ}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {居座|いすわ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {居座|いすわ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stay put; to remain (too long); to refuse to leave
definitions.explanation: To settle into a place and not move, often overstaying one's welcome. Also used figuratively for weather systems, political figures clinging to power, or problems that persist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{居座|いすわ}った。
examples.english: The customer stayed until closing time and wouldn't leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居座|いすわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon is stalled over southern Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|や}めず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居座|いすわ}り⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The president clung to his position without resigning, even with poor performance.

notes:
USAGE:
{居座|いすわ}る carries a negative connotation of remaining somewhere when one should leave. It combines {居|い}る (to be/stay) with ⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ (to sit), giving the image of someone planting themselves firmly in place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居座|いすわ}り⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue to stay put)
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{居座|いすわ}る (a typhoon stalls)
- ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居座|いすわ}る (to cling to one's position)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Conjugation: {居座|いすわ}らない (negative), {居座|いすわ}って (te-form), {居座|いすわ}った (past). Godan verb ending in る (ら{行|ぎょう}).
